prompt: texinfo-format-region missing closing brace error message
answer: `texinfo-format-region` reports a missing closing brace as **“Unbalanced parentheses”**, not “Unbalanced braces.” It treats brace mismatches as though they were parentheses. Check the `*Info Region*` buffer; the cursor will be just after where the error was detected.
